approved_by: repository owner — explicit instruction: bring the whole Linux 4.3.2 feature set to the Windows build and publish it
evidence: Release source 8c2419f4a5dcbb3abb7ad927ccf5758d164f471c applies the owner-approved navigation and Siraj identity changes to Android, Windows and Linux.
Android places About as the final Settings item; Windows and Linux place About directly after Settings while showing the owned icon above an Amiri Siraj wordmark.
Android 1.4.4, Windows 4.1.4 and Linux 4.1.3 use independent platform versions and the desktop tags point to this exact reviewed source commit.

Android bundle verification, responsive browser checks, JavaScript and Python syntax checks, 86 desktop unit tests, YAML parsing, provenance checks, audio-source verification and high-severity npm audit passed locally.
Each release workflow must still pass its complete locked-data, UI, packaging, signing, SBOM and provenance gates before publication; desktop promotion independently verifies every Draft asset.

Linux 4.3.0 (source a215cdbaef2cb2079b3903b521f28df938e3bdd8) unifies the reciter picker per riwaya (Hafs 183, Warsh 16, Qalun 16, Duri 11), removes the separate reader-library window, moves downloads onto the chosen reciter, and scrolls the reader to the playing ayah.
92 Linux unit tests pass locally (skipped=1) and ui_test.py passes 76 checks; the only two failures are the pre-existing offline-tafsir store checks that CI resolves by fetching the locked store.
Desktop layout is untouched: mushaf page rendering, wide-screen composition and the side tab rail with About last remain as approved.

Root cause reproduced: the 4.1.1 frozen bundle has no zoneinfo module at all (PyInstaller analysis of launcher.py lists no zoneinfo), so patch 4.3.1 died at main.py line 9 with ImportError before any window appeared; running the signed patch through the real 4.1.1 launcher reproduced the silent death exactly.

Linux 4.3.2 (source 012c40e) makes the zoneinfo import optional, pins PYTHONTZPATH before importing, and every signed patch now carries the unmodified CPython 3.13 zoneinfo package so prayer-time offsets and DST keep working inside the frozen bundle.

Verified end to end in a simulated 4.1.1 frozen bundle that has no stdlib zoneinfo: patch 4.3.2 installs, verifies, starts, renders the mushaf (page 1, 114 surahs, hasMushaf true) and computes correct offsets (London 0/1, Cairo 2/3, Tokyo 9). The same run with zoneinfo blocked everywhere still opens the app.

96 Linux unit tests pass locally (skipped=1) including a new guard test that fails if any patchable module imports a module absent from the frozen bundle; audiotest reports ok true for Hafs and Warsh.

The 4.3.2 release tag points at f34572f, the audited approval commit whose parent ccdc1b3 is the verified fix; the repository protects published tags, so the gate approves the tagged commit itself instead of moving the tag.

Windows 4.1.5 (source b7ae224) is a real three-way merge of windows_app/main.py with the Linux 4.3.2 line: one searchable reciter list per riwaya (Hafs 182, Warsh 14, Qalun 14, Duri 9), downloads with the chosen reciter on the same card, auto-scroll to the playing ayah with highlight, prayer times, qibla, adhan and reminders, wird ring and reading minutes, plus share card.

Prayer data needed a real port: windows_app/adhan_scheduler.py now dispatches to Windows Task Scheduler one-shot tasks (schtasks /SC ONCE) with per-prayer refresh, while systemd stays the Linux path; both platforms share the same module and tests.

Frozen-bundle safety repeats the Linux lesson: the 4.1.4 Windows bundle has no zoneinfo module and Windows has no system tz database, so every Windows patch now ships the CPython 3.13 zoneinfo package plus 55 TZif files under windows_app/tzdata, and a guard test fails if any patchable module imports something absent from the 4.1.4 bundle.

Verified end to end: the signed 4.1.5 patch installs into a simulated 4.1.4 frozen bundle whose interpreter has no zoneinfo, starts, renders the mushaf, and resolves Cairo/London/New York offsets with DST from the bundled database only.

59 Windows unit tests pass (skipped=1) and ui_test.py completes with only the two offline-tafsir store checks that CI resolves by fetching the locked store; audiotest reports ok true for Hafs and Warsh.
accepted_risks: The 728866816-byte locked offline tafsir store was not downloaded into the local workspace; both mandatory desktop workflows fetch, hash and verify it before their full UI suites can pass.
Windows executables intentionally have no Authenticode signature; patch integrity is provided by Ed25519 signatures and SHA-256 asset digests.

schtasks task creation is exercised only through its command plan and a skip-flag dry run locally; the Windows CI runner executes the build, unit tests and UI test, and any Task Scheduler rejection surfaces in-app as a status message rather than a crash.
